title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Further Improving the Commissioned Mediation Mechanism
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Further Improving the Entrusted Mediation Mechanism

Fa Fa [2020] No. 1

To the Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

To thoroughly implement the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism, the Guiding Opinions on Further Improving the Entrusted Mediation Mechanism of the Supreme People's Court are hereby issued for your implementation in light of actual circumstances. If you encounter any problems during implementation, please promptly report them level by level to the Supreme People's Court.

January 9, 2020

Guiding Opinions on Further Improving the Entrusted Mediation Mechanism

To implement the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, promote the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity, deepen the comprehensive and coordinated reform of the judicial system, improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism, and further strengthen and standardize entrusted mediation work, these Guiding Opinions are formulated in accordance with the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Specially Invited Mediation by People's Courts, and other laws and judicial interpretations, taking into account the actual work of the People's Courts.

1. Guiding Ideology. Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era, improve the mechanism for governing the sources of litigation, and effectively prioritize non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms to meet the diverse, efficient, and convenient dispute resolution needs of the broad masses. Carry out entrusted mediation work in accordance with the principles of legality, voluntariness, and due process, continuously promote the improvement of a social governance system led by the Party Committee, responsible by the government, with democratic consultation, social coordination, public participation, legal guarantees, and technological support, and build a community of social governance where everyone has responsibility, everyone fulfills their responsibility, and everyone enjoys the benefits.

2. Scope of Mediation. For disputes involving people's livelihood interests, except those that are legally unsuitable for mediation, the People's Court may entrust specially invited mediation organizations or specially invited mediators to conduct mediation. For typified disputes such as property management, traffic accident compensation, consumer rights protection, and medical damage compensation, the People's Court shall play a demonstrative role in entrusted mediation to promote effective dispute resolution.

3. Professional Dispute Resolution. The People's Court shall strengthen coordination with relevant departments, fully leverage the advantages of administrative agencies in administrative mediation and administrative adjudication mechanisms, leverage the professional advantages of industry-specific and specialized mediation organizations, and utilize the opinions of notarization institutions, appraisal institutions, and experts in relevant fields to provide professional support for dispute resolution and enhance the professional level of entrusted mediation.

4. Guidance and Notification. For disputes brought to the People's Court by the parties, if the parties apply for mediation or agree to mediation after being guided by the court, the People's Court may, before registering the case, entrust a specially invited mediation organization or specially invited mediator to conduct mediation, and the parties shall sign the "Entrusted Mediation Notification Letter." If a party does not agree to mediation, they shall sign a clear opinion upon receiving the "Entrusted Mediation Notification Letter." After receiving the written materials indicating the party's disagreement with entrusted mediation, the People's Court shall promptly transfer the case to the litigation procedure.

5. Case Filing and Jurisdiction. For cases subject to entrusted mediation, a "pre-litigation mediation" case number shall be assigned, and the litigation materials shall be transferred to the specially invited mediation organization or specially invited mediator within three days to conduct mediation. In the event of a jurisdictional dispute, the People's Court that first assigned the "pre-litigation mediation" case number shall be deemed the court that first filed the case.

6. Judicial Guarantees. The People's Court shall actively provide necessary judicial guarantees for administrative organs, people's mediation committees, social comprehensive governance centers, dispute mediation centers, and other mediation organizations entrusted to carry out mediation work.

7. Appraisal and Evaluation. Explore the conduct of pre-litigation appraisal and evaluation. For disputes over traffic accident compensation, medical damage compensation, and other tort liability disputes, if appraisal and evaluation can facilitate mediation between the parties, upon the application of the parties, the specially invited mediation organization or specially invited mediator shall report to and obtain the consent of the People's Court, and the People's Court shall organize the appraisal or evaluation in accordance with the procedures. The period for appraisal and evaluation in entrusted mediation shall not be counted in the time limit for entrusted mediation.

8. Material Transition. Improve the mechanism for transitioning materials between mediation and litigation. Mediation materials that have clearly informed the parties of their relevant rights and legal consequences and have been agreed to by the parties during entrusted mediation may, upon review by the People's Court and if they comply with laws and judicial interpretations, be used as litigation materials.

9. Mediation Time Limit. The time limit for entrusted mediation by the People's Court is 30 days. With the consent of both parties, the mediation time limit may be extended. The time limit for entrusted mediation shall be calculated from the date when the specially invited mediation organization or specially invited mediator confirms receipt of the materials transferred by the court. If no agreement is reached within the time limit or if a party expressly refuses to continue mediation, the case shall be promptly transferred to the litigation procedure in accordance with the law.

10. Case Closure Report. If an entrusted mediation case is terminated due to failure to reach a mediation agreement, the specially invited mediator who accepted the entrustment shall issue a case closure report and transfer it together with the relevant mediation materials to the People's Court. The case closure report shall include the reason for terminating the mediation, the focus of the dispute, the status of evidence exchange between the parties, the record of undisputed facts, conduct that increases the litigation costs of other parties, and other matters that need to be brought to the attention of the court. For professional issues involved, clear opinions may be provided in the case closure report.

11. Performance of Agreement. If the parties reach a mediation agreement through entrusted mediation, they shall follow the principle of good faith and timely and fully perform the obligations agreed in the agreement. If a party applies to the People's Court that entrusted the mediation for judicial confirmation, the People's Court shall accept it in accordance with the law.

12. Punishment Mechanism. For conduct by a party that abuses rights, violates the principle of good faith, or intentionally obstructs mediation, resulting in increased litigation costs for other parties, the People's Court may, as appropriate, increase the proportion of litigation costs borne by that party. If an innocent party requests compensation for additional expenses incurred in pre-litigation mediation, the People's Court may, as appropriate, support such request.

13. Guidance and Supervision. The People's Court shall assign judges to guide entrusted mediation work, standardize mediation conduct, and improve mediation quality. Judges may supervise specially invited mediators who engage in irregular conduct during the mediation process through criticism, education, or ordering rectification. If a specially invited mediation organization or specially invited mediator is unable to perform their duties, the People's Court shall remove them from the specially invited mediation roster in accordance with relevant provisions.

14. Platform Development. The People's Court shall strengthen the construction, application, and promotion of mediation platforms, enhance the connection between the mediation platform and other institutional mediation platforms, improve the connection mechanism between litigation and non-litigation dispute resolution methods, and achieve online handling of mediation cases, online circulation of mediation data, and online sharing of mediation information, comprehensively enhancing the capability for diversified dispute resolution.

15. Data Utilization. Fully utilize the data resources of the People's Court Big Data Management and Service Platform and the People's Court Mediation Platform, improve and perfect the management system for entrusted mediation cases, provide data support for the performance evaluation of judges guiding entrusted mediation, and provide statistical basis for trial management by the People's Court. Strengthen the monitoring and early warning functions of judicial big data, improve the risk assessment mechanism for disputes, and provide decision-making reference for Party committees and governments.

16. Incentive Mechanism. Increase the weight of entrusted mediation in performance appraisal systems, and refine supporting incentive mechanisms and work plans. For mediation judges and specially invited mediators who facilitate the automatic performance of mediation agreements by the parties, provide incentives through performance evaluation; for mediation organizations and mediators with outstanding achievements or other notable contributions in mediation work, provide commendations and rewards in accordance with national regulations, and take relevant work performance as an important basis for other types of evaluations and awards, maximizing the work enthusiasm of various mediation entities such as mediation judges, specially invited mediation organizations, and specially invited mediators.

17. Guarantee Mechanism. Actively seek support from local Party committees and governments to further improve the level of supporting guarantees for entrusted mediation personnel, venues, facilities, and funds, and strengthen personnel training and management.
